verdict.rationale: Generating or editing workflows from a prompt is a fair question for a workflow automation tool, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a natural-language workflow builder or AI assistant that creates or edits workflows. The closest items are a use case ('Convert natural language into API calls'), which describes what a built workflow does, and the template library; both are adjacent and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate or edit a workflow from a natural-language prompt
